portalIndex.label: SIGINT / Signals Intelligence Collection & Analysis
portalIndex.answersQuestion: Where is signal-collection capacity, COMINT/ELINT yield, and processing-exploitation-dissemination throughput emerging or fracturing?

portalIndex.label: HUMINT / Human Intelligence Networks & Tradecraft
portalIndex.answersQuestion: How healthy are human-source networks, recruitment pipelines, and clandestine tradecraft against denied-area access?

portalIndex.label: GEOINT / Geospatial & Imagery Exploitation
portalIndex.answersQuestion: What is imagery/geospatial exploitation rate, sensor tasking efficiency, and overhead-reconnaissance coverage?

portalIndex.label: MASINT / Measurement & Signature Intelligence Readiness
portalIndex.answersQuestion: What is technical-sensor readiness for measurement and signature detection (radar, acoustic, nuclear, chemical signatures)?

portalIndex.label: OSINT / Open-Source Collection & Verification
portalIndex.answersQuestion: What is open-source verification quality, deepfake/disinformation resistance, and source-provenance discipline?

portalIndex.label: All-Source Analysis & Assessment Fusion
portalIndex.answersQuestion: How well are INTs fused into all-source assessments per ICD 203 analytic standards, and is analyst competency holding?

portalIndex.label: Counterintelligence & Insider-Risk Detection
portalIndex.answersQuestion: What is counterintelligence detection rate against penetration, insider risk, and foreign interference?

portalIndex.label: Threat Warning & Indications Assessment
portalIndex.answersQuestion: Is the indications-and-warning loop catching strategic surprise, or is warning latency widening?

portalIndex.label: Covert Action & Influence Operations
portalIndex.answersQuestion: What is the posture and accountability of covert action and information/influence operations within authorized boundaries?

portalIndex.label: Oversight, Clearance & Compliance
portalIndex.answersQuestion: Is the IC operating within legal authorities (FISA, EO 12333), and is the security-clearance/insider-risk regime sound?

accessTierLegend.UNCLASSIFIED: Public/open routing — OSINT and oversight-compliance portals reachable without clearance gating.
accessTierLegend.TS-SCI: Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information — collection, analysis, counterintel, warning, and covert-action portals gated behind clearance + need-to-know in the certified-cortex layer.

notes: Honest stub: structural deep-portal tree not yet built (counts intentionally zero/empty, mirroring defense + technology ports). portalIndex is the routing/identity layer only — maps the 10 named intelligence portals (SIGINT/HUMINT/GEOINT/MASINT/OSINT/all-source/counterintel/warning/covert-action/oversight) to activation nodes, evidence families, and clearance-gated access tiers so the analyst interface can enumerate intelligence portals before the full tree is authored. Intelligence identity = collection + all-source analysis + espionage/counterintelligence + threat warning + covert action + oversight; DISTINCT from defense (kinetic/readiness) and technology (cyber tooling is a coupling, not the identity). NOT energy content. Tickers are real intel-sector firms.
